technical.summary: Short-term momentum is overbought with conflicting intermediate signals; strong trend structure exists but price remains below key moving averages and cloud, creating a high-risk entry with limited confluence.

fundamental.summary: DOC shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying presence, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 35 days create near-term uncertainty.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (16/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absence of congressional buying and zero news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (364.48), flat yield curve recession risk, rising dollar headwind, and credit stress create severely unfavourable macro conditions for real estate sector; earnings in 35 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: ADX strong + Hull/Supertrend bullish with extreme fear sentiment (16/100) creates contrarian setup near support (20.3989) in oversold conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all major moving averages and Ichimoku cloud, RSI overbought on short-term but bearish on 14-period, zero fundamental support, VIX crisis regime (364.48), high credit spreads, and earnings risk in 35 days create overwhelming headwinds that invalidate technical signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure shows ADX strength and bullish Hull/Supertrend with price at support, but this is overwhelmed by price trapped below all major moving averages, overbought RSI-9, and bearish RSI-14 signaling momentum exhaustion rather than reversal.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis regime (364.48), elevated credit spreads, unfavourable macro environment for real estate, and earnings event in 35 days create systemic headwinds that invalidate technical support; downside break below 20.3989 likely in risk-off conditions.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical, fundamental, and macro all point to elevated risk despite contrarian sentiment signal
decision.portfolio_note: Already 11 positions in Real Estate sector; adding DOC increases concentration risk in unfavourable macro environment without fundamental or institutional conviction to justify sector overweight.
